CASE6495RTE
AC Power flow data for French system.
Please see CASEFORMAT for details on the case file format.
This case accurately represents the size and complexity of French
very high voltage and high voltage transmission network.
These data are snapshots of French VHV+HV grid in 2013.
These data can be used to validate mathematical methods and tools.
These data should NOT be used for operation
nor planning of the French or European grids.
When publishing results using this data, please cite:
C. Josz, S. Fliscounakis, J. Maeght, and P. Panciatici,
"AC Power Flow Data in MATPOWER and QCQP Format: iTesla, RTE Snapshots, and PEGASE"
http://arxiv.org/abs/1603.01533
Contacts (primary contact for this file : Jean Maeght):
Cédric Josz, Stéphane Fliscounakis, Jean Maeght, Patrick Panciatici
